title: How to Prepare for BBL Laser
h1: How to prepare for BBL laser treatment
desc: How to prepare for BBL (BroadBand Light) in Dubai: sun and tanning, skincare to pause, medicines to mention and what to do on the day, from Skin & Laser.
answer: Before BBL, keep the area out of the sun and avoid tanning, including self-tanner, for at least 2 weeks. Pause retinoids and exfoliating acids on the area for 3 to 7 days, tell us about any medicines and a history of cold sores, and arrive with clean skin and no make-up.
facts: A test spot may be done
body:
## Your checklist

- Stay out of direct sun and use SPF 50 daily in the weeks before
- No sunbeds or self-tanner for at least 2 weeks
- Pause retinol, retinoids, AHAs and BHAs on the area 3 to 7 days before
- Shave the area the day before if it has hair
- Remove make-up, creams and fragrance on the day

## Medicines and health

Some medicines make skin more sensitive to light, including certain antibiotics and isotretinoin, which usually needs to be stopped for several months first. If you get cold sores and are having the face treated, tell us beforehand. BBL is usually postponed during pregnancy.

## Is BBL right for your skin?

BBL suits lighter, untanned skin best. Read [is BBL suitable for all skin types?](/blog/bbl-skin-types/) and [can I tan before and after BBL?](/blog/bbl-tanning-before-after/)

## After your session

Aftercare matters just as much. See [what to do after BBL](/blog/bbl-aftercare/).
faq: Can I have BBL if I was in the sun last week?
If your skin is tanned or sunburnt, the session is usually postponed until it settles.
Should I stop my skincare before BBL?
Pause retinoids and exfoliating acids on the area for 3 to 7 days; gentle cleanser and moisturiser are fine.
Do I need a test spot?
Often for a first treatment, especially on darker or sensitive skin.
